management_steps.details: Oral formulations: suspension 125 mg/5 mL, suspension 250 mg/5 mL, capsule 250 mg, capsule 500 mg.

Children: Amoxicillin, oral, 10-20 mg/kg 8 hourly for 5 days. Weight >11-25 kg: 250 mg (10 mL of 125mg/5mL, 5 mL of 250mg/5mL, or 1 capsule of 250 mg). Weight >25 kg: 500 mg (2 capsules of 250 mg or 1 capsule of 500 mg). Adults: Amoxicillin, oral, 500 mg 8 hourly for 5 days.
